app_title: CX MultiNotes Editor - Your notes, everywhere
logo_text2: This is a Beta version of the app. If you wish to gain access, please write to multinotes.web@gmail.com
hero_subtitle: Open, edit, and organize your MultiNotes on any device — no install required.
feature1_title: A space that feels like yours
feature1_text: Clean layout, readable typography, and just the right amount of structure — so you can focus on what matters.
feature2_text: Colors, search, and simple formatting — so your notes stay tidy without extra work.
feature3_title: On your phone, tablet, or laptop
feature3_text: Your notes stay in sync across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux — wherever you work.
feature4_text: Data is read from your Google account, where it is securely protected. Use your notes even without an internet connection - whenever you need them.
speed_text: Notes are remembered (cached) after the first launch, then only new and changed ones are loaded.
cache_p1: Notes are kept in the browser's memory for quick access.
cache_p2: Working with a local database makes you independent of an internet connection.
cta_p1: Sign in once. Access your notes on any device, anytime — online or off.
cta_p2: Use the same Google account you use on your Android device.
